method: Isolated diagnostic executable, explicit profiling environment switch. All successful cold misses joined to completed save records by exact cache key. Aggregate per-job elapsed durations overlap across four Cargo jobs and are not additive critical-path savings. Postcompile includes save plus producer linking-input collection/revalidation and forwarding/materialization. Inner save phases are a subset of postcompile. Instrumentation is diagnostic, not an A/B optimization result.
